Interview Role

Senior System Design Engineer

Topic DomainURL Shortener (e.g. TinyURL)
Evaluation Focus Points

  • •Chooses Base62 encoding or MD5/SHA256 truncation with collision resolution
  • •Selects appropriate DB (NoSQL like Cassandra/DynamoDB or SQL with auto-increment ID mapping)
  • •Implements Redis cache layer for high-read throughput
  • •Addresses redirection HTTP status codes (301 Permanent vs 302 Temporary)
